rows.name: stage-video_call-screen
rows.evidence: A video call window is open with a running timer and call controls like Mute and Leave visible.

rows.name: stage-video_precall
rows.evidence: The screen shows a 'Ready to join?' prompt with a 'Join' button, meaning the call has not started yet.
rows.nextHint: Click the blue Join button to start the call.

rows.name: stage-video_ended

rows.goal: I want to video call my granddaughter Lily

steps.i: Click on Lily's name in the contact list on the left.
steps.target: White rectangular row on the upper left showing a green circle with 'L', the name 'Lily', and 'Granddaughter · Online'

steps.i: Click the video call button that appears in Lily's details on the right.
steps.target: Button with a video camera icon or 'Video call' label inside the right-hand contact details panel

rows.goal: Make the writing on my screen bigger

steps.i: Click the three little dots in the top right corner of the screen.
steps.target: Three small dark vertical dots stacked on top of each other, located in the top right corner of the window, below the X button.

steps.i: Find the word Zoom in the list and click the plus sign next to it.
steps.target: A row inside the white menu box with the word 'Zoom', a minus sign, a number with a percent symbol, and a plus sign '+'.

steps.i: Click the plus sign again until the writing is a comfortable size for your eyes.
steps.target: The same plus sign '+' button on the 'Zoom' row inside the open white menu box.

steps.i: Click once on an empty part of the main page to close the menu.
steps.target: Any large blank or white area in the middle or left side of the screen, away from the open menu box.

rows.goal: Check whether a text message from my bank is a scam

steps.i: Look at the sender's name or number at the top of the screen.
steps.target: Top center of the message screen, grey or black text showing a phone number or name above the message bubbles

steps.i: Read the message words to see if it asks you to hurry or panic.
steps.target: Large grey or blue rounded rectangle bubble in the center of the screen containing black or white text

steps.i: Look for any blue or underlined web address in the message, and do not touch it.
steps.target: Blue or underlined text inside the message bubble, often containing dots and slashes

steps.i: Check with a person you trust or call the number on the back of your bank card.
steps.target: Bottom or side button to close the screen, or putting the device down to look at a physical plastic bank card
